context7._description: Context7 — injects up-to-date library documentation into the LLM context. Add 'use context7' to any prompt to activate. No API key required for basic use.
context7._usage: In any Copilot CLI prompt, append 'use context7' to get current docs for the library you are using.
context7._example_prompt: How do I set up a Next.js App Router with Prisma? use context7
